GENERATE BURST K1-gen-01 — Keeper of Hours identity masters (charter § 7 K1; MILESTONE: Matt picks 1 of 3). task_id "K1-gen-01".

Deliver EXACTLY THREE independent candidates of the SAME figure, one image_gen call each, from the description below — do not vary the design between candidates; only the model's natural variation differs. Names: out/k1_master_A.png, out/k1_master_B.png, out/k1_master_C.png. NO retries: three calls total; calls_used must equal 3.

DESCRIPTION (use it verbatim as the content of each call):
Keeper of Hours — STARTER identity master. One full-body figure, facing the camera (direction S), projection C (elevated three-quarter), standing, feet visible, weight even, arms relaxed with the rod held upright in the RIGHT hand. Identity: a young archivist, early 20s, dark curly hair tied back, sun-browned skin, face fully visible, no helmet. Costume (every item is an instrument or carries one): ivory linen shirt with rolled sleeves under a navy wool sleeveless tabard; ONE chestnut leather harness strap running from the right shoulder diagonally to the LEFT hip where it carries an olive waxed-canvas satchel with brass corners; ONE chestnut leather waist belt whose buckle closes the tabard; chestnut leather laced bracers on both forearms; navy wool trousers; chestnut leather buckled boots. Weapon: an astrolabe-rod — a dark walnut shaft with a BRASS RING HEAD; the ring carries a single radial hour-mark. Signature motif: the same single open ring with one radial hour-mark appears EXACTLY ONCE on the tabard chest panel and once as the rod head, and NOWHERE ELSE — every other surface is plain and undecorated: no trim, no edge ornament, no secondary sigils, no compass diagrams, no studs. Register: painted 2D, illustrated, clean material planes, restrained surface texture, no conspicuous brush or pixel grain. Light: single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on the key-facing edge; no spell glow; NO floor shadow. Flat uniform pure #00ff00 background covering the whole canvas; do not matte. Image 1 is a STYLE reference for the painted register only — do not copy its figure, its costume, its emblems or its ornament.

Copy each output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/ with the exact names above and compute its sha256. No code. No other files. No web. No agents.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "K1-gen-01"): images = the three files with prompt, references (role + path), elapsed_s; calls_used = 3; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything you could not honour. Never PASS/FAIL.
